name: Titanium: Sponge, Alloy & Mill Products for Aerospace and Defence
scope: India makes only ~500 tpa of titanium sponge (KMML, unlisted, flat since 2011) and imports aerospace-grade sponge from Russia, Japan and China, while Tejas ramp-up (24 to 30 aircraft/yr, 180 on order), AMCA and submarines pull on one thin domestic alloy chain (MIDHANI); fresh Aug-Sep 2026 moves (Adani Ports' Rs 16,000 cr Srikakulam ilmenite-to-slag/TiO2/sponge proposal, Russia's Giredmet-Alt Metals sponge pilot) show the bottleneck is being attacked. Early and thinly covered as a titanium-specific theme (MIDHANI down ~5% over a year, PTC Industries up ~31% in 6 months, partly on its casting/EBCHR story); it overlaps the Defence & Aerospace backlog theme but focuses on the upstream material, and sponge plants are multi-year and unlisted-heavy, so this is a long-dated option.
questions: What is the titanium value chain (ilmenite/rutile to slag, sponge, ingot/alloy, mill products, castings/forgings, tubes) and where is India short? Quantify sponge capacity and import dependence.
What is driving demand now: Tejas Mk1A/Mk2 rate, AMCA, submarines, civil aerospace offsets, and how fast is Indian titanium consumption growing per industry reports?
What has happened in the last 1-3 months (Adani Ports Srikakulam proposal, Giredmet-Alt Metals pilot, KMML-SAIL JV idea, IREL-Kazakh slag JV) and what is still only a proposal?
What exactly is MIDHANI doing in titanium (production volumes, capacity, expansion capex, qualification with GE/HAL/ISRO) and what are its supply constraints on sponge?
What is the status of PTC Industries' Odisha titanium sponge MoU, its EBCHR/PAM plants and aerospace titanium castings, and what capex, timeline and customers are confirmed?
Does Adani Ports (APSEZ) have any filing, board approval or mining-lease approval behind the Srikakulam titanium plant, and how material is it to APSEZ?

Which other listed companies have verified titanium activity (e.g. Venus Pipes & Tubes titanium welded tubes, Ratnamani, aerospace machining/forging names) and is each genuinely titanium-linked rather than only sector-adjacent?
Across small, mid and large caps, how have these stocks performed over 6-12 months, and have broker or mainstream media already grouped them as a titanium theme?
What are the risks: project slippage (PTC's EBCHR already slipped), import-price swings, long qualification cycles, concentration on defence orders, valuation (MIDHANI P/E ~57)?
What near-term catalysts exist: sponge plant approvals, MIDHANI expansion and order flow, PTC commissioning, mineral lease approvals, any titanium PLI or policy support?

upstream_sponge_ore: Companies planning titanium slag/sponge, the scarcest link in India's chain
alloy_and_castings: Producers of titanium alloy, melted ingot and precision titanium components for defence/aerospace
tubes_and_mill_products: Makers of welded titanium tubes and other mill-form titanium for industrial uses
